title: ExternalEvent
description: Normalized timed calendar event. All-day events are deferred.

id.description: Stable opaque event identifier, unique across event sources.

endTime.description: Exclusive end time; must be later than startTime. This relationship is checked by the consumer.

attendees.description: Normalized attendee labels (display names or email addresses), not provider attendee objects. Omitted means unknown; [] means no attendees.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.
